summary: DESIGN 11.2 implemented on ent-bom/FC-1 (fours). (1) Supersede switch: vox_work_orders._enabled and vox_catalogue_stock._enabled keep all previous checks (scope, malformed config still raises), and only when the pilot would be enabled they ask kit_pos.connector.production.engine_policy(company); a policy with supersedes_vox_pilot is True and mode 'on' or 'paused' makes them return False. ImportError, a missing function or any exception keeps the previous answer (True). The policy is read as attributes or as a mapping, so either Policy shape EN-1 picks works. Effects: route_invoice_warehouses / ensure_invoice_production / finalize_invoice_valuation are no-ops for Vox and the availability provider returns {}; guard_invoice_trace still runs first in both hooks. (2) ensure_negative_stock_for_doc runs one SQL per document (UNION of BOM.item and BOM Item.item_code, docstatus=1, is_active=1, parenttype='BOM', any company, restricted to the document's codes) and skips those rows before any balance lookup; the Vox MENU exclusion is unchanged and a MENU-only Vox sale issues no query. (3) mark_reconciled (and so on_stock_reconciliation_submit) clears custom_negative_stock_auto_enabled for every counted item but resets allow_negative_stock only for items that are NOT rows of an active submitted BOM; dishes (VXN-DRY-GOAT etc.) and all other items are reset as before. Pilot guards, credit-pilot guards/verifier and modifiers are untouched and pinned by source hash in the new U20 module. W0-SNAP: ent-bom/main (1cd7654) already is the production tree, so no stacked merge was needed and there is nothing to rebase onto.

risks: Supersede requires supersedes_vox_pilot to be exactly True and mode exactly 'on' or 'paused'. If EN-1 normalises these differently (e.g. 1, 'ON'), the pilot stays enabled and the engine sees ENGINE_CONFLICT_PILOT (fails closed and visible, not silent). LB/EN-1 reviewers should confirm the Policy shape.

Protected-function hash pins (test_kit_bom_supersede.PROTECTED) will fail on any later edit to those guards: intended (DESIGN 11.2 item 4), but a future reviewed change must update the hashes deliberately.

By the scope's rule, mark_reconciled keeps the flag for every row of an active BOM, which includes sub-assemblies that are dishes too: today only VX-0134-1 CHAPATI (row of Rolex BOM-88760-002; VXN-GOAT-PORTION is not a row of any BOM in the extract). Its flag goes to 0 only by the lead's D4/D6 data writes (DESIGN 7.4); a count will not reset it. The helper never sets it to 1 either.

The helper's BOM query is per document (not per process): one extra indexed query on every SI/DN before_submit while enable_negative_stock_automation=1, including ddamu's documents if fours runs there (core ERPNext tables only, schema-safe).

If the BOM query itself raises (DB failure), the before_submit / Stock Reconciliation on_submit fails instead of silently guessing; previously only set_value failures were swallowed in mark_reconciled.
